head: 29d9b7f7
headSubject: fix(sec-3): memory-limited plugin children exit on their first OutOfMemoryError
summary: Closed the long-running Postgres integration-test hang and took every CI workflow on main to green (incl. the PR-only AI Knowledge Gate and PR Gate, never watched on main -- PR Gate first green since 2026-08-29). Hang: a CI watchdog (80c24c25: jstack + pg_locks on 7 min silence) showed a cross-connection deadlock -- a create-orchestration INSERT on its own pooled connection waiting on the caller's @Transactional row lock (fixed bd48bcbf: join the caller's Spring connection under a SAVEPOINT). Also: in-memory TraceStore was a no-op so /api/v1/traces 404'd for every in-memory app (f058157c, summaries d3d750af); Linux plugin limiter claimed cgroup containment systemd silently ignored (18d6dc9d) and memory-limited plugin children now exit on first OOM (29d9b7f7, proven live on a GitHub runner); fast-uri CVE; ControlPanel stop leaked the process tree; firstrun harness SIGPIPE race under pipefail; POSIX zombie in npdev host stop; allowlist-citation checker never enforced corpus allowlist (fail-open); portability fixes (drive letters, nav probe on Linux, AI knowledge gate libs staging); NPDevCli coverage ratchet restored with tests.
nextStep: All CI is green; nothing red is known. Two owner decisions are open, neither blocking: (1) REG-250 -- NPDevSamples/pigmentampas pins packs[] to a one-machine git+file:// pack repo, allowlisted in corpus-parse-allowlist.json meanwhile; decide whether a showcase may depend on a public pack repo (NPR) or needs a repo-relative coordinate form. (2) run-beta-release-gate (T3, deferred) is red on release posture: missing/stale producer reports plus runtime-footprint / runtime-surface-classification drift (14 controllers + 50 services whose package does not match their convergence bucket) -- a package-reorg decision, not a bug. If neither is picked up, the next useful step is dispatching the manual AI Beta Gate / Release Gate workflows (last run 2026-08-31, both red) to see what is real there.
blocked: Nothing blocked; REG-250 and the release-posture drift await an owner decision.
verified: Local: generator, kernel, RuntimeHost (3 runs, last green with the OOM flag), aiKnowledge (coverage fixed), weekly paperwork gates all green; navigation probe passes locally. CI on 29d9b7f7/1297da2a: NPDev CI Validation (Linux maturity incl. Postgres integrationTest + segmented), Security scan, Engine support, AI Knowledge Gate, PR Gate all success; First-run harness success on 20a13eeb; Kernel gate + Storage conformance success on 042b8900. PluginIpcChildProcessLinuxResourceLimitTest memory-ceiling case ran (not skipped) and passed on a GitHub runner (1.39s).
